# PingClass

> PingClass is a tuition and coaching institute management platform for India: students, batches, attendance, fees, teachers and parents in one dashboard. Free for up to 20 students; paid plans start at ₹249/month.

## What it does

- Batch-wise attendance with at-risk visibility for admin and teachers.
- Fee tracking and collection with automatic reminders and parent payment history.
- Role-based dashboards for admin, teacher and parent.
- Parent notifications for attendance and fees (replacing WhatsApp chaos and daily phone calls).
- Built specifically for tuition/coaching institutes and small centres, not generic ERP accounting software.

- [Tuition Fees: Monthly Subscription vs Course Fee, Which is Better](https://www.pingclass.in/blog/tuition-fees-subscription-vs-course): comparing monthly subscriptions, term fees and course-based pricing.

- [Free Tuition Management Software in 2026: What You Actually Get](https://www.pingclass.in/blog/free-tuition-management-software): what free tools really cover and when free stops being enough.
- [Why Tally and Full ERPs Are Overkill for a Tuition Center](https://www.pingclass.in/blog/why-tally-erp-overkill-tuition-center): comparing general ERPs against dedicated tuition management software.
